newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials up at midday, market mixed.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials up at midday, market mixed.

text.p: The Dow industrials were higher at midday Wednesday but analysts were unsure whether the market had bottomed out.
The Dow industrials were up 11 points at 6598; declines led advancing issues by six to five. U.S. Treasuries were weak, with the long bond down 13/32 to yield 7.13 percent.
"The question is whether this is a dead cat bounce, just a knee-jerk response after selling reached a peak," said Alfred Goldman, technical analyst at A.G. Edwards & Sons.
